NpcFollowing.object.debug.stick.descript: Debug item: Force an NPC to follow, including unlisted or non-social NPCs, regardless of recruitment conditions; use again to dismiss
NpcFollowing.object.location.tool.name: Location Tool
NpcFollowing.object.location.tool.descri: Debug item: A tool for location related operations
NpcFollowing.recruit.Abigail.accept: An adventure? I was hoping you'd ask! Let's see what we can find.$h

NpcFollowing.recruit.Alex.rejectLate: It's late. I need some rest if I'm going to be any use out there tomorrow.

NpcFollowing.recruit.Harvey.reject: I'm sorry. I'd feel more comfortable if we knew each other a little better before taking that sort of trip.
NpcFollowing.recruit.Harvey.rejectLate: It's quite late. A full night's sleep would be the healthier choice for both of us.
NpcFollowing.recruit.Leah.accept: I'd love to. A change of scenery might give me an idea for my next sculpture.$h
NpcFollowing.recruit.Leah.reject: I think I'll stay close to home today. Let's get to know each other a bit better first.
NpcFollowing.recruit.Leah.rejectLate: It's getting late, and I should head home. Let's leave the exploring for tomorrow.

NpcFollowing.recruit.Maru.reject: Maybe once we've spent a little more time together. I'd like to know my expedition partner better.

NpcFollowing.recruit.Penny.rejectLate: It's already so late. I'd rather we set out when we're both well rested.

NpcFollowing.recruit.Sam.rejectLate: I'd be falling asleep on the trail. Let's do this tomorrow!

NpcFollowing.recruit.Sebastian.rejectLat: I'm still awake, but a trip right now? I'd rather leave it for tomorrow.
NpcFollowing.recruit.Shane.accept: Fine, I'll come. Beats standing around here all day.
NpcFollowing.recruit.Shane.reject: No thanks. I don't know you well enough to go charging off somewhere with you.
NpcFollowing.recruit.Shane.rejectLate: Not tonight. I'm worn out. Ask me before it gets this late.
